# Pixel Tip Calculator

A tiny offline tip calculator with a pixel-art look. Enter a bill amount, pick a tip percentage (10%, 15%, or 20%), and set the number of people. The app shows the tip per person and the total per person.

## Run it

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step, no server, no network requests.

## Features

- Bill amount input (decimal values supported)
- Tip percent buttons: 10%, 15%, 20% with an active pressed state
- Number of people input (minimum 1)
- Live results: tip per person and total per person
- Keyboard accessible with visible focus states and labeled controls
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Pure HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript; no dependencies

## Files

- `index.html` – structure and controls
- `style.css` – pixel theme, layout, and states
- `script.js` – calculation and button handling

## Accessibility notes

- All inputs have associated `<label>` elements.
- Tip buttons use `aria-pressed` to indicate the selected option.
- Results are announced via an `aria-live` region when values change.
- Focus-visible outlines and pressed states are provided for all interactive controls.
